test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Accept’ is related to ‘Decline’ in the same way as ‘Captivity’ is related to ‘________’.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• ‘Accept’ is related to ‘Decline’ → Accept is antonym of Decline.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Captivity’ is related to ‘________’ → Captivity is antonym of Freedom.

Hence, '**Freedom**' is the correct answer.
